text: YHWH reigns! In majesty He is robed. YHWH has girded Himself [with] strength. Surely the world is established; no more can it be shaken.
Your throne [is] established from that time; You [are King] from everlasting.
The floodwaters have lifted up, O YHWH, the streams have lifted up their voice; the streams have lifted up their breakers.
More than the voices of many waters, [more] majestic [than] the breakers of the sea, majestic on high [is] YHWH!
Your testimonies are fully confirmed; Your house is lovely [in] holiness, O YHWH, for the length of days.
